parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure its uniqueness across different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The renewal duration for all prepaid resources of the service instance. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description: The time unit for the renewal duration of all prepaid resources of the service instance, which is the unit of the Period parameter. Valid values: Month, Year. Default value: Month.
